name: oh-my-design
summary: CLI that installs design skills, DESIGN.md contracts and company references into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode.
description: A CLI that installs local design workflows into an existing coding agent: a portable DESIGN.md (declared philosophy, decision ids, tokens bound to those decisions), component contracts with anatomy, state matrices and accessibility, numbered quality gates, and 500+ quality-graded company references. It ships 28 skills, 20 specialist roles and 93 preset contracts; omd book serves the system locally or exports a static HTML file for handoff. Core workflows need no API key, daemon or MCP server.
contains: 28 skills, 20 specialist roles, 93 preset contracts, 500+ quality-graded references
installs into Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Cursor channels
DESIGN.md Core v2: seven semantic anchors, decision ids (D-xx) bound to tokens
54 slop gates plus 8 system-fidelity gates; 45 component-craft norms
omd book renders the system locally or writes a static HTML file
no API key, daemon or MCP server for core workflows
